import (
	"bytes"

	flag.BoolVar(&toml, "toml", false, "parse input as TOML")

			os.Exit(2)
		}
		input = buf.String()
	}

	if len(args) == 0 {
		if input == "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: no input provided\n")
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		args = []string{"<stdin>"}
	}

	// Process input

	var err error

	if yaml {

		os.Exit(1)
	}

		fmt.Println(input)
	} else {

	}
}

func parseJSON(input string, args []string) (interface{}, error) {

	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &data); err != nil {
		filename := extractFilename(args[0])
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("SyntaxError: Invalid flags supplied to RegExp constructor '%s' at %d:%d",
			filename,
			strings.Index(input, filename)+1,
			strings.Index(input, filename)+1)
	}
	return data, nil
}

func extractFilename(input string) string {
	// Extract filename from input (basename only)
	basename := filepath.Base(input)
	if idx := strings.Index(basename, ".json"); idx != -1 {
		return basename[:idx] + ".json"
	}
	return basename
}
